prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 500Lクラス冷蔵庫6機種の比較 (language ja).
Grid: 6 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "機種" spans 1 col × 2 row; "性能" spans 3 col × 1 row; "価格（税込）" spans 1 col × 2 row; "特徴（長い説明）" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "機種" · longest unbreakable word 68px · one-line width 188px
  col 2: header "性能 › 消費電力" · longest unbreakable word 35px · one-line width 82px
  col 3: header "性能 › 容量" · longest unbreakable word 29px · one-line width 41px
  col 4: header "性能 › 騒音" · longest unbreakable word 19px · one-line width 56px
  col 5: header "価格（税込）" · longest unbreakable word 59px · one-line width 92px
  col 6: header "特徴（長い説明）" · longest unbreakable word 56px · one-line width 1295px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
This table cannot fit without splitting words at 360px. You MAY choose a total wider than 359px (the reader then scrolls horizontally), or squeeze and accept splits — a design decision.
Rendering convention: the screenshot always shows the WHOLE table. Anything beyond the dashed box is not clipped; it is the part a reader reaches by scrolling sideways, so judge both what fits in the box at first sight and the cost of scrolling to the rest.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"500Lクラスの冷蔵庫6機種を、性能、税込価格、特徴から比較して選ぶ。","reading":"機種名を起点に行を横にたどり、消費電力・容量・騒音・価格を縦に見比べたうえで、候補の特徴を読む。スマートフォンでは最初に見える列と横スクロール先の関係が重要。","groups":["消費電力・容量・騒音は共通の「性能」見出しを持つ比較項目で、互いに近く、数値を縦に追いやすくする。","機種と価格は購入候補を識別し、予算と照合するための基準になる。","特徴は各機種の定量化しにくい違いを説明し、性能・価格の比較を補う。"],"keep_intact":["機種名の型番や英数字のまとまり","消費電力・容量・騒音の数値と単位","税込価格の数値"],"may_wrap":["メーカー名と型番の間","特徴欄の説明文","必要に応じて日本語の見出し。特徴文によって生じる行の高さに、機種名などの折り返しを収められる。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [117, 103, 62, 77, 113, 220] · table 693×1058px · row heights [36, 36, 153, 176, 153, 176, 153, 176] · column headers wrapped 0/7 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 333px
Design r1B: widths [110, 96, 62, 77, 113, 200] · table 659×1198px · row heights [36, 36, 176, 199, 176, 199, 176, 199] · column headers wrapped 0/7 · tallest cell 8 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 299px
Design r1C: widths [130, 103, 62, 77, 113, 300] · table 786×826px · row heights [36, 36, 129, 129, 129, 129, 106, 129] · column headers wrapped 0/7 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 426px

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"機種と性能3項目がほぼ画面内に収まり、消費電力・容量・騒音の値を一行で縦に比較できる。見出しの階層も明瞭。","problems":"複数の型番がハイフンで分かれ、機種を素早く識別しにくい。価格は画面外で、特徴による高い行のため性能列に大きな空白ができる。","cause":"機種列117pxではメーカー名と型番を適切な位置で折り返す余裕が不足する。特徴列220pxの文章折り返しが行高を押し上げ、価格列は性能列の後ろに配置されている。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"性能3項目の列は初期表示に収まり、価格列の存在も右端に見える。横スクロール量は3案で最も少ない。","problems":"メーカー名や型番が分かれ、消費電力も「年」が次行に落ちる。行がさらに高くなり、数値の縦比較に必要な視線移動が増える。","cause":"機種列110pxと消費電力列96pxは内容に対して狭い。特徴列200pxも説明文を多く折り返し、全列の行高を広げる。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"特徴列が広いため行高が抑えられ、6機種の比較全体を追いやすい。消費電力と容量は一行で読め、見出しの階層も明瞭。","problems":"騒音の値が画面右端で切れ、性能3項目を初期表示だけで比較できない。型番の一部はハイフンで分かれ、価格と特徴を見るための横スクロールも長い。","cause":"機種列130pxと性能列の合計が画面幅を超える。機種列はメーカー名と型番を常に別行に収めるには不足し、特徴列300pxは全体幅を大きくする。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced","widths":[117,103,62,77,113,270],"change":"r1Aの初期表示に性能3項目が収まる構成を保ち、特徴列を270pxに広げて行高を抑える。型番の折り返しと横スクロール量の妥協点を確かめる。"},{"name":"model-first","widths":[145,103,62,77,113,270],"change":"機種列を145pxに広げ、メーカー名と型番の間での折り返しを促す。騒音列の一部が初期表示の外に出る代わりに、候補の識別を優先する。"},{"name":"price-in-view","widths":[95,103,62,77,80,270],"change":"機種列と価格列を狭め、価格の数値が初期表示にどの程度現れるか試す。機種名や価格見出しの折り返しを許容し、性能と予算を同時に見渡せる可能性を検証する。"}]}
